playbackTemplateSpec.name: O-MicrotonalSampler
playbackTemplateSpec.creator: Ouaricon Audio
playbackTemplateSpec.description: Loads O-MicrotonalSampler with family-aware technique-keyswitch routing. Strings staves bind the Strings exp-map (Sul pont., Sul tasto, Stacc., Con sord., Pizz., Harm., Trem.). Woodwinds bind the Winds exp-map (Flutter-tongue, Whisper, Multiphonic, Key click, Slap-tongue, Harm., Stacc.). Brass binds the Brass exp-map (Mute, Cuivre, Flutter-tongue, Stopped, Growl, Fall). All other families fall back to the Generic exp-map. Microtonal pitch deltas route via VST3 Note Expression (kTuningTypeID); dynamics via CC11.
